name: Pathoparalysis Mine
effect:
3/Scene, you can deploy a pathoparalysis mine anywhere within Sensor range.

Whenever a hostile character enters within Burst 2, the mine explodes.
This will leave behind a Burst 2 cloud that whenever a biological character enters or starts their turn within, they gain the Pathoparalysis status.

name: Neurax Worm
description: Unlike traditional system hacking, the Neurax Worm physically launches from the mech and burrows into the Target. This causes physical damage to the mech during this process as it attempts to take over.

actions.name: Launch Neurax Worm
actions.detail:
The Target must perform a Hull save and a Systems save.

If the Hull save fails, the Target takes 1d4 Kinetic damage that is considered Armor Piercing (AP).
If the Systems save fails, the Target takes 2 Heat.

name: Stucry
description: Stucry, an advanced virus designed to cause the Target's systems to start misbehaving and misfiring.

actions.name: Launch Stucry
actions.detail: Upon success, the Target fires with a random weapon chosen by the GM at a random character within range of said weapon. If there is not a valid Target for any of their weapons, then they fire upon themselves with a random weapon chosen by the GM.

name: CyWire
description: CyWire, a virus meant to cause havoc on a Target mech by rewiring parts of the mech.

actions.name: Launch CyWire
actions.detail:
Upon success, you may choose two mech stats of your Target (Hull, Agility, Systems, Engineering). The values of these two stats are swapped until the end of your next turn.

You cannot use this on a Target already suffering from this attack.

name: Reactive Systems
description: A simple AI unit designed to react for you to incoming damage.
effect: You get two types of reactions that each can be used 1/Round: Ranged Reaction and Melee Reaction.

actions.name: Ranged Reaction
actions.detail:
Roll a 1d6. On 5+, you move to an adjacent unoccupied space and the attack effectively misses.
This must be taken before the attack roll is made.
actions.trigger: An enemy attempts a ranged attack on you.

actions.name: Melee Reaction
actions.detail:
Roll a 1d6. On a 5+, you move to an adjacent unoccupied space and the attack effectively misses.
This must be taken before the attack roll is made.
actions.trigger: An enemy attempts a melee attack on you.

name: Weapon Hand Over
description: A specialized boost targeting the NHPs of your current mech.
effect:
1/Scene, you hand over control of one of your mech's weapons to an NHP of your mech. For the rest of the scene on your turn, you may attack with this weapon once as a free action without any bonuses.
However, any systems or actions relating to the NHP can no longer be used including protocols and mech talents and/or effects. This NHP can still cascade as well.

This ends once the Scene end.

actions.name: Hand Over Weapon
actions.detail:
Hand over control of one of your mech's weapons to an NHP of your mech. For the rest of the scene on your turn, you may attack with this weapon once as a free action without any bonuses.
However, any systems or actions relating to the NHP can no longer be used including protocols and mech talents and/or effects. This NHP can still cascade as well.

This ends once the Scene end.

name: Movinull
description: A simple virus designed to sabotage the movement systems on a target mech.
effect: 1/Round, you may select a Target for this. Your Target must make a Systems save. Upon failure, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn. Upon success, they become Slowed until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Launch Movinull
actions.detail: Your Target must make a Systems save. Upon failure, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn. Upon success, they become Slowed until the end of their next turn.

name: Lock Wave
description: An advanced virus meant to expose targets, making them easier to target.
effect: 1/Scene, you can emit a wave from your mech to force a lock on to all enemy mechs within Sensor range.

actions.name: Launch Lock Wave
actions.detail: Emit a wave from your mech to force a lock on to all enemy mechs within Sensor range.

name: Cessamech
description: An advanced virus that can force a mech to shut down.
effect:
1/Round, you may select a Target for this. Your Target must make a Systems save. Upon failure, they must roll 3d6. If they roll a 1 on any die, their mech is forced to Shut Down, otherwise, they become Immobilized.

You may force one of these effects like this on each character only once per scene.

actions.name: Launch Cessamech
actions.detail:
Your Target must make a Systems save. Upon failure, they must roll 3d6. If they roll a 1 on any die, their mech is forced to Shut Down, otherwise, they become Immobilized.

A character may only be affected by this once per scene.

name: Sensibility
description: A simple systems module designed to give a boost to a mech's sensors.

name: Electronic Hardening
description: A slightly more advanced systems module designed to give a boost to a mech's electronical defenses.

name: Hack Boost
description: A slightly more advanced systems module designed to give a boost to a mech's hacking capabilities.

name: Flash Feet
description: A module allowing for insane movement at the cost of damaging one's reactor.
effect: 3/Scene, you may select a Target for this within Sensor range. You must make an Overcharge roll and subsequently immediately teleport to an unoccupied adjacent space to your Target. After this, the effects of the Overcharge roll kick in, additionally you become Immobilized until the end of your next turn.

actions.name: Flash Feet
actions.detail: Select a Target for this within Sensor range. You must roll an Overcharge roll and subsequently immediately teleport to an unoccupied adjacent space to your Target. After this, the effects of the Overcharge roll kick in; additionally you become Immobilized until the end of your next turn.
